# Next steps

Sources: `state/STATUS.md`, the experiment journals and plan 3. Nothing in this chapter is a result.

## Status

- Plans 1 and 2 are complete as executed.
- Plan 3 has results for E12–E17. E18 was not conducted, because no usable monitoring data exist. E19 (this synthesis)
  is done.
- Independent audits cover everything except the main E08 64² tests and the two E16 VanLeer cells.

## Open decisions and known gaps

- Whether to make a memory-matched reference design the default going forward. That would be a preregistered choice for
  any new confirmatory test.
- E03 remains rank deficient for structural reasons.
- E04's spectrum-versus-coverage hypothesis is untested across seeds.
- No experiment has used real concentration data. E17 uses real winds only, and E18 found no usable monitors.
